title: Relux
tagline: Relux is a Blockchain-Backed Luxury Marketplace where sellers can list certified and tokenised luxury goods.
description: Relux is a mobile-based revolutionizing the luxury goods market with blockchain technology. Our platform exclusively lists genuine luxury items certified by their manufacturers, ensuring that buyers receive authentic products. Each item on Relux is tokenized and represented by a unique NFT, providing unparalleled traceability and security. Upon purchase, the NFT is transferred to the buyer, creating a verifiable on-chain record of ownership. Relux combats contraband and guarantees the authenticity of luxury goods, offering buyers the confidence and assurance they deserve.
how_its_made:
Our mobile application leverages the Web3Auth SDKs to enable a seamless and fast login experience using social platforms like Google and Twitter. The marketplace lists items in USDC, ensuring stability and ease of transactions. All transactions are processed using this stablecoin for a reliable and consistent user experience.

To ensure security, flexibility, and affordability, our marketplace is deployed on multiple Layer 2 networks (including Scroll, Zircuit, Base, and Arbitrum). This multi-chain approach enhances scalability and reduces transaction costs for our users.

We utilize Blockscout's APIs to verify our smart contracts, ensuring transparency and security in every transaction. Additionally, we integrate Blockscout’s blockchain explorer links on our website, providing users with easy access to detailed transaction histories and contract information.
